{{Top|leg}}
The '''Sovar Imperial Hotel''' was a [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] in [[Equator City/Legends|Equator City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was located in the same entertainment complex as the [[Flip of the Credit]] [[Casino/Legends|casino]].
